```{python}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
import os, sys, json, warnings
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, joblib
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from scipy.stats import ks_2samp

def find_repo_root(start, name="CreditRiskLearning"):
    p_ = os.path.abspath(start)
    while True:
        if os.path.basename(p_) == name:
            return p_
        parent = os.path.dirname(p_)
        if parent == p_:
            raise FileNotFoundError(name)
        p_ = parent

REPO = find_repo_root(os.getcwd())
sys.path.append(os.path.join(REPO, "Core Resources"))
sys.path.append(os.path.join(REPO, "Core Resources", "Scripts"))
from python_style_util import p, f, s, C
from deck_utils import deck_style
deck_style()

plt.rcParams.update({"font.size": 13, "axes.titlesize": 16, "axes.labelsize": 14,
                     "xtick.labelsize": 13, "ytick.labelsize": 13, "legend.fontsize": 13})

def card(num, label, note="", num_size=56, colour="#3D2E4F"):
    n = f"<div style='font-family:monospace;font-size:{num_size}px;font-weight:700;color:{colour};line-height:1.05'>{num}</div>"
    l = f"<div style='font-size:15px;letter-spacing:0.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#8A6D1F;margin-top:10px'>{label}</div>"
    t = f"<div style='font-size:16px;color:#3a3a3a;margin-top:4px'>{note}</div>" if note else ""
    return f"<div>{n}{l}{t}</div>"

def grid(items, cols):
    return ("<div style='display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(%d,1fr);gap:28px;margin-top:20px'>" % cols
            + "".join(items) + "</div>")

def pretty(name):
    return DISPLAY.get(name, name.replace("_", " ").title())

PROJ = os.path.join(REPO, "Projects", "Flagship PD Model Project")
INPUT = os.path.join(PROJ, "02_PD_Model_Development", "inputs")
REG = os.path.join(PROJ, "05_Applicant_PD_Dashboard", "registry", "logreg_baseline_v1")

champ = joblib.load(os.path.join(REG, "model.joblib"))
with open(os.path.join(REG, "metadata.json")) as fh:
    meta = json.load(fh)
FEATS = meta["features"]

DISPLAY = {
    "EXT_SOURCE_1": "External Credit Score 1", "EXT_SOURCE_2": "External Credit Score 2",
    "EXT_SOURCE_3": "External Credit Score 3", "DAYS_EMPLOYED": "Job Tenure",
    "ANNUITY_CREDIT": "Annuity-to-Credit Ratio", "AMT_GOODS_PRICE": "Goods Price",
    "OCCUPATION_TYPE": "Occupation", "CREDIT_GOODS": "Credit-to-Goods Ratio (LVR)",
    "ORG_BAND": "Organisation Band", "NAME_INCOME_TYPE": "Income Type",
    "REGION_RATING_CLIENT_W_CITY": "Regional Rating", "NAME_EDUCATION_TYPE": "Education",
}

train = pd.read_parquet(os.path.join(INPUT, "train_woe.parquet"))
test = pd.read_parquet(os.path.join(INPUT, "test_woe.parquet"))
y_tr, y_te = train["TARGET"], test["TARGET"]

pd_tr = champ.predict_proba(train[FEATS])[:, 1]
pd_te = champ.predict_proba(test[FEATS])[:, 1]
gini_tr = 2 * roc_auc_score(y_tr, pd_tr) - 1
gini_te = 2 * roc_auc_score(y_te, pd_te) - 1
gap = gini_tr - gini_te
ks_te = ks_2samp(pd_te[y_te.values == 1], pd_te[y_te.values == 0]).statistic
BASE = y_te.mean()

rank = pd.Series(pd_te).rank(method="first")
decile = pd.qcut(rank, 10, labels=False) + 1
dec = pd.DataFrame({"pd": pd_te, "y": y_te.values, "decile": decile.values}).groupby("decile").agg(
    n=("y", "size"), rate=("y", "mean"), avg_pd=("pd", "mean"))
n_rev = int((dec["rate"].diff().dropna() <= 0).sum())   # decile reversals

coef = pd.Series(champ.coef_[0], index=FEATS)
n_neg = int((coef < 0).sum())
ext_top = all(k.startswith("EXT_SOURCE") for k in coef.abs().nlargest(3).index)

PASS = lambda ok: "PASS" if ok else "FAIL"
```

## Model Summary {.hero data-kick="Performance"}

```{python}
#| output: asis
print(grid([
    card(f"{gini_te:.3f}", "Test Gini", "Discrimination on unseen applicants", num_size=44),
    card(f"{ks_te:.3f}", "Test KS", "Separation between the two outcome groups", num_size=44),
    card(f"{gap:+.3f}", "Train/Test Gini Gap", "Stability between training and test", num_size=44),
    card(f"{n_rev}", "Decile Reversals", "Risk ranking holds across all deciles", num_size=44),
], 2))
```

## What the Model Predicts {data-kick="Target"}

The model estimates each applicant's probability of repayment difficulty.

```{python}
#| output: asis
print(grid([
    card("0", "TARGET = 0", "No repayment difficulty", num_size=96),
    card("1", "TARGET = 1", "Repayment difficulty", num_size=96),
], 2))
```

Dataset-specific default proxy. Not a Basel default definition.

## Pre-Fit Success Criteria {data-kick="Validation"}

Criteria were defined before model fitting to provide a consistent basis for validation.

```{python}
#| output: asis
print(grid([
    card("≥ 0.45", "Test Gini", "Minimum discrimination threshold", num_size=44),
    card("≤ 0.02", "Train/Test Gini Gap", "Limits deterioration between training and test", num_size=44),
    card("Consistent", "Coefficient Signs", "Aligned with the expected direction of risk", num_size=36),
    card("0", "Decile Reversals", "Risk rises across successive deciles", num_size=44),
], 2))
```

## Results Against Criteria {data-kick="Validation"}

```{python}
#| output: asis
def status(ok):
    c = "#2E7D32" if ok else "#B23B3B"
    return f"<span style='color:{c};font-weight:700'>{'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'}</span>"
print(grid([
    card(f"{gini_te:.3f}", "Test Gini", f"Criterion ≥ 0.450 · {status(gini_te >= 0.45)}", num_size=44),
    card(f"{gap:+.3f}", "Train/Test Gini Gap", f"Criterion ≤ 0.020 · {status(abs(gap) <= 0.02)}", num_size=44),
    card(f"{n_neg} of {len(coef)}", "Coefficients negative", f"Credit logic aligned · {status(n_neg == len(coef) - 1)}", num_size=44),
    card(f"{n_rev}", "Decile Reversals", f"Criterion = 0 · {status(n_rev == 0)}", num_size=44),
], 2))
```

The one positive coefficient is Income Type (`{python} f"{coef['NAME_INCOME_TYPE']:+.3f}"`, 95% CI -0.03 to 0.14). The interval spans zero, so the coefficient is noted rather than treated as a failed sign.

## Rank Ordering {data-kick="Validation"}

```{python}
#| fig-width: 10.5
#| fig-height: 4.8
#| out-width: "100%"
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10.5, 4.8))
x = dec.index.values
ax.plot(x, dec["rate"].values * 100, marker="o", color=p("jacaranda", 300), linewidth=3.5,
        markersize=9, label="Observed repayment difficulty")
ax.plot(x, dec["avg_pd"].values * 100, marker="s", color=p("gold", 300), linewidth=1.8,
        linestyle="--", markersize=6, label="Predicted PD")
ax.set_xticks(x)
ax.set_xlabel("Predicted-risk decile (1 = lowest risk, 10 = highest)")
ax.set_ylabel("Rate (%)")
ax.legend(frameon=False, loc="upper left")
ax.grid(axis="x", visible=False)
```

**Observed repayment difficulty increases across all ten predicted-risk deciles, with `{python} f"{n_rev} reversals" if n_rev else "zero reversals"`.**

## Model Coefficients {data-kick="Interpretability"}

```{python}
#| output: asis
tbl = coef.reindex(coef.abs().sort_values(ascending=False).index)
def half(items):
    rows = "".join(f"<tr style='border-bottom:1px solid #E6E0EC'><td style='padding:7px 10px'>{DISPLAY.get(k, k)}</td>"
                   f"<td style='padding:7px 10px;text-align:right;font-family:monospace'>{v:+.3f}</td></tr>" for k, v in items)
    return ("<table style='font-size:18px;width:100%;border-collapse:collapse'><thead><tr style='border-bottom:2px solid #3D2E4F'>"
            "<th style='text-align:left;padding:6px 10px'>Feature</th><th style='text-align:right;padding:6px 10px'>Coefficient</th>"
            "</tr></thead><tbody>" + rows + "</tbody></table>")
items = list(tbl.items())
print("<div style='display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:36px;margin-top:8px'>"
      + half(items[:6]) + half(items[6:]) + "</div>")
```

**`{python} "External credit scores have the largest coefficients in the baseline model." if ext_top else "Coefficient ranking to be reviewed."`**

## Model Limitations {data-kick="Limitations"}

**Target definition.** Repayment difficulty is a dataset-specific proxy, not a Basel default definition.

**External scores.** Model performance depends materially on the external credit-score variables.

**Validation scope.** The model has not undergone production validation. Gender is excluded as a protected attribute, and proxy checks on retained fields are a next step.
